capabilities.scope: Restricted successful unsplit API-upload scans; no configured workflows/AI. Any unexpected child graph fails admission.

configuration.completion: all native-equivalent tracked task states/results, search readiness and scheduler terminal events
configuration.lifecycle_limits: DBWorker has no equivalent hard timeout, cancellation or child recycling; success contract only
configuration.submission: authenticated POST /api/documents/post_document/ via native APIClient routing
configuration.timing: first authenticated API upload through final expected business and task completion; oracle hashing outside timer

metrics.resource_scope: harness, Redis, worker replacements and OCR descendants; SQLite is in-process
metrics.short_lived_process_sampling_limit: Processes born and exited between 50ms samples may be missed
